name: ESC-50: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification
allowed_use: Non-commercial research and educational prototyping only
attribution: Piczak, K. J. (2015). ESC: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification. ACM Multimedia.
notes: Contains 2,000 environmental audio recordings across 50 classes. Strict CC BY-NC licence prohibits commercial exploitation.

name: UrbanSound8K
allowed_use: Non-commercial research and educational prototyping only
attribution: Salamon, J., Jacoby, C., and Bello, J. P. (2014). A Dataset and Taxonomy for Urban Sound Research. ACM Multimedia.
notes: Contains 8,732 urban sound excerpts across 10 classes in 10 pre-arranged folds. Strict CC BY-NC licence.

name: FSD50K: Freesound Dataset 50K
allowed_use: Clip-level allowlist required based on individual sound licence
attribution: Fonseca, E., et al. (2021). FSD50K: an open dataset of human-labeled sound events. IEEE/ACM TASLP.
notes: Licence varies per Freesound audio clip. Only clips with explicit verified permissive licences (CC0 or CC-BY) are allowlisted for unconstrained prototypes.

name: AudioSet (Evaluation Reference Subset)
licence_or_terms: YouTube Terms of Service / CC BY 4.0 (annotations)
allowed_use: Academic evaluation reference only; no audio redistribution
attribution: Gemmeke, J. F., et al. (2017). Audio Set: An ontology and human-labeled dataset for audio events. IEEE ICASSP.
notes: Referenced strictly for evaluation ontology cross-verification. No raw audio redistribution; external download script with authorised API credentials required.
